description: Parses Recycle Bin $I files and INFO2 files.
usage: Parses Recycle Bin $I files and INFO2 files to show what was deleted, from where, when and its original size. Use it to recover evidence of deleted files.
limitation: Lists only items still in the Recycle Bin. Emptied items and files deleted with Shift+Delete leave no record here.

parameters.label: $I / INFO2 file
parameters.description: File to process. Either this or -d is required.

parameters.label: Recycle Bin directory
parameters.description: Directory to recursively process. Either this or -f is required.
Only show the filename being processed vs all output. Useful to speed up exporting to CSV.
